shalimar-bagh.localIntro: Shalimar Bagh, under pincode 110088, takes its name from the Mughal-era garden in its village quarter, where the restored Sheesh Mahal recalls the site of Aurangzeb's coronation. The modern colony is a mix of plotted kothis in lettered blocks, rebuilt builder floors and DDA flats, home to established families, elderly residents and professionals working across north Delhi. Fortis Hospital Shalimar Bagh is the area's best-known institution, the Pink Line stops at Shalimar Bagh station, and the Yellow Line runs close by at Haiderpur Badli Mor and Azadpur, beside the sprawling Azadpur wholesale mandi. Ashok Vihar adjoins to the south, Pitampura to the west and Model Town across the Azadpur side, so households and helpers move easily between these colonies. Helpers commonly come from Haiderpur village and Jahangirpuri nearby; block associations manage lanes rather than gated towers, so entry is usually straightforward once timings are fixed with the household.
shalimar-bagh.commuteNotes: The Pink Line's Shalimar Bagh station serves the colony directly, with the Yellow Line close by at Haiderpur Badli Mor and Azadpur; helpers from Haiderpur and Jahangirpuri often walk or take a short shared-auto ride in.
shalimar-bagh.housingNotes: Plotted kothis, builder floors and DDA flats share the colony, managed by block RWAs rather than gated towers, so helper entry usually needs no pass beyond an occasional register entry in the DDA blocks.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Shalimar Bagh service cover?
localFaqs.a: Shalimar Bagh falls under pincode 110088, covering its lettered residential blocks and the village quarter near the Mughal garden. Ashok Vihar (110052) and Pitampura (110034) are separate localities.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Shalimar Bagh do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Coverage extends to Ashok Vihar, Pitampura, the Azadpur side, Model Town and the adjoining Rohini sectors. Helpers frequently work across two or three of these colonies in a day.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Shalimar Bagh need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Mostly not: the colony is plotted kothis and builder floors where households manage entry, with block RWAs overseeing the lanes. In the DDA flat pockets, a simple register entry may be asked for.

nizamuddin.localIntro: Nizamuddin, under pincode 110013, is one of South Delhi's most distinctive heritage quarters, split between the quiet plotted lanes of Nizamuddin East and the busier Nizamuddin West beside the historic basti. Households here are largely long-settled families and senior professionals living in low-rise independent houses, many of them older bungalows on tree-lined streets, with a steady mix of tenants drawn by the central location. The neighbourhood sits beside some of Delhi's best-known monuments — Humayun's Tomb and Sunder Nursery border Nizamuddin East, while the Hazrat Nizamuddin Dargah anchors the western side — and Hazrat Nizamuddin Railway Station keeps the area well connected for intercity travel. Jangpura lies immediately across Mathura Road, with Defence Colony and Lajpat Nagar a short drive south and Lodi Road to the west. Daily cleaning help, cooking support and elder care are the common requirements, given the number of older residents and single-family homes that prefer consistent, long-term domestic staff.
nizamuddin.commuteNotes: Hazrat Nizamuddin Metro Station on the Pink Line and the nearby Sarai Kale Khan ISBT make the area easy to reach, with buses running along Mathura Road. Many helpers also walk in from Nizamuddin Basti and the Bhogal side of Jangpura.
nizamuddin.housingNotes: Mostly low-rise independent houses and older bungalows, especially in Nizamuddin East, so households deal with staff directly and timings stay flexible. There are few gated towers or formal entry-pass systems here.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Nizamuddin do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: The surrounding colonies — Jangpura, Defence Colony, Lajpat Nagar and Lodi Road — are covered by the same nearby helper pool. Both Nizamuddin East and Nizamuddin West fall under this locality's coverage.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Nizamuddin service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Nizamuddin falls under pincode 110013, which includes both Nizamuddin East and Nizamuddin West. Neighbouring Jangpura carries its own pincode, 110014, but is served by the same nearby helper network.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Nizamuddin need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Most homes here are independent houses rather than gated towers, so formal society passes are generally not required. Households usually manage entry and timings directly with the helper.

jangpura.localIntro: Jangpura, with pincode 110014, sits between the Nizamuddin heritage belt and the busy markets of Lajpat Nagar, and combines three distinct pockets — Jangpura proper, Jangpura Extension and the old Bhogal settlement. Housing is dominated by builder floors raised on compact plots, home to a mix of long-settled families and younger working professionals who rent here for the central location. Bhogal Market gives the area its everyday commercial pulse, while Jangpura Metro Station on the Violet Line and the nearby Hazrat Nizamuddin Railway Station keep it well connected; Humayun's Tomb stands a short distance away on the Nizamuddin side. Defence Colony lies to the west and Lajpat Nagar just across the Ring Road to the south, so households, helpers and services move fluidly between these colonies. Families here typically look for part-time cleaning and cooking help on fixed morning and evening slots, and many helpers live within walking distance in Bhogal itself.
jangpura.commuteNotes: Jangpura Metro Station on the Violet Line sits at the colony's edge and buses ply Mathura Road. A large share of helpers live in Bhogal and simply walk to work.
jangpura.housingNotes: Builder floors on compact plots dominate, with individual landlords rather than housing societies, so entry is informal and part-time slots are easy to arrange.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Jangpura do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Nizamuddin, Defence Colony, Lajpat Nagar and Lodi Road are all close by and served by the same helper pool. Bhogal and Jangpura Extension are covered as part of Jangpura itself.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Jangpura service cover?
localFaqs.a: Jangpura falls under pincode 110014, which takes in Jangpura, Jangpura Extension and Bhogal. Neighbouring Nizamuddin is 110013 and Lajpat Nagar is 110024.

localFaqs.q: How do helpers usually reach homes in Jangpura?
localFaqs.a: Many helpers live in Bhogal and walk to nearby homes, while others arrive via Jangpura Metro Station on the Violet Line or by bus along Mathura Road. Fixed morning and evening time slots are the norm here.

hauz-khas.localIntro: Hauz Khas, under pincode 110016, pairs one of Delhi's most visited heritage precincts — the Hauz Khas Fort and lake beside Deer Park — with established residential pockets such as Hauz Khas Enclave, Safdarjung Development Area and Hauz Khas Apartments. The housing stock is genuinely mixed: plotted houses and builder floors in the Enclave blocks, DDA-built flats in SDA, and group-housing blocks closer to the Outer Ring Road. Residents are largely working professionals and families, including many connected to IIT Delhi and the institutional belt across the Ring Road, alongside older households that have lived here for decades. Aurobindo Market and the SDA market complex handle daily needs, and Hauz Khas Metro Station, an interchange between the Yellow and Magenta lines, makes commuting straightforward. Green Park adjoins to the north, Safdarjung Enclave to the north-west and Malviya Nagar across the Outer Ring Road to the south, so domestic help arrangements here often mirror those in the surrounding colonies.
hauz-khas.commuteNotes: Hauz Khas Metro Station, an interchange of the Yellow and Magenta lines, is the main access point, supported by buses along the Outer Ring Road and Aurobindo Marg.
hauz-khas.housingNotes: A mix of plotted builder floors in Hauz Khas Enclave, DDA flats in SDA and some group-housing blocks; the apartment blocks usually require helper registration at the gate, while builder floors and plotted houses do not.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Hauz Khas do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Green Park, Safdarjung Enclave, Malviya Nagar and Munirka are all adjacent and use the same helper network. SDA and Hauz Khas Enclave are covered within Hauz Khas itself.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Hauz Khas need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: In SDA flats and the apartment blocks near the Outer Ring Road, helpers are usually registered at the gate. Builder floors and plotted houses in Hauz Khas Enclave normally have no formal pass requirement.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Hauz Khas service cover?
localFaqs.a: Hauz Khas falls under pincode 110016, which it shares with neighbouring Green Park. Coverage includes Hauz Khas Enclave, SDA and the blocks around the Hauz Khas market area.

green-park.localIntro: Green Park, sharing pincode 110016 with neighbouring Hauz Khas, is a leafy plotted colony split into Green Park Main and Green Park Extension. Most homes are builder floors raised on the original plots, with two to four independent apartments per building, which keeps the area popular with families and working professionals who want low-rise living near the Yellow Line. Green Park Metro Station sits on Aurobindo Marg at the colony's edge, Green Park Main Market and its surrounding lanes cover daily shopping, and Deer Park offers morning-walk greenery next door; AIIMS Delhi is a short distance up Aurobindo Marg, so many doctors and hospital staff rent homes here. Hauz Khas adjoins to the south, Safdarjung Enclave lies across to the west, and the busy Yusuf Sarai market strip runs along the northern edge. Households commonly hire part-time maids and cooks on morning shifts, with helpers walking in from the adjacent Gautam Nagar and Yusuf Sarai settlements.
green-park.commuteNotes: Green Park Metro Station on the Yellow Line sits on Aurobindo Marg at the colony's edge. Helpers typically arrive by metro or walk in from the adjacent Gautam Nagar and Yusuf Sarai settlements.
green-park.housingNotes: Almost entirely builder floors on private plots with individual owners, so there are no society gate passes and households set their own timings.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Green Park service cover?
localFaqs.a: Green Park falls under pincode 110016, which it shares with adjacent Hauz Khas. Coverage takes in both Green Park Main and Green Park Extension.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Green Park do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Hauz Khas, Safdarjung Enclave, Malviya Nagar and Munirka are all nearby and covered by the same helper network. Many helpers work in more than one of these colonies on the same day.

localFaqs.q: How do helpers usually reach homes in Green Park?
localFaqs.a: Most helpers walk in from the adjacent Gautam Nagar and Yusuf Sarai settlements, while others use Green Park Metro Station on the Yellow Line. Morning shifts before office hours are the most common arrangement.

safdarjung-enclave.localIntro: Safdarjung Enclave, under pincode 110029, is a well-established South Delhi colony of lettered blocks where the original plots now mostly carry builder floors, giving it a low-rise, family-oriented character. The urban village of Humayunpur sits within the colony and adds a dense pocket of shops, eateries and rental housing. The medical belt defines much of daily life here: AIIMS Delhi and Safdarjung Hospital lie just across the Ring Road, so many households are doctors, hospital staff and medical families on shift-based schedules. Bhikaji Cama Place, one of South Delhi's major office complexes, adjoins the colony's western side, and Deer Park's green spread lies towards Hauz Khas. Green Park adjoins to the east, with Hauz Khas beyond it and R.K. Puram to the west. Demand runs strongly to part-time cleaning, cooking and elder-care support, and many helpers live within walking distance in Humayunpur itself.
safdarjung-enclave.commuteNotes: Green Park on the Yellow Line and Bhikaji Cama Place on the Pink Line are the nearest metro stations, with Ring Road buses close by. Many helpers live in Humayunpur inside the colony and walk to work.
safdarjung-enclave.housingNotes: Builder floors across the lettered blocks with a few apartment pockets; entry is generally informal and managed by individual households rather than society gates.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Safdarjung Enclave service cover?
localFaqs.a: Safdarjung Enclave falls under pincode 110029, covering the colony's lettered blocks and the Humayunpur village pocket within it. Neighbouring Green Park and Hauz Khas fall under 110016.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Safdarjung Enclave do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Green Park, Hauz Khas, R.K. Puram and Munirka are all close by and share the same helper network. The Bhikaji Cama Place office district adjoins the colony as well.

localFaqs.q: Can helpers in Safdarjung Enclave work around hospital shift timings?
localFaqs.a: Yes — many households here are AIIMS and Safdarjung Hospital staff, so early-morning and evening slots are common requests. Since most helpers live in adjacent Humayunpur, flexible walk-in timings are usually workable.

malviya-nagar.localIntro: Malviya Nagar, pincode 110017, is one of South Delhi's busiest mid-market residential hubs, packed with builder floors on compact plots and a rental market that draws young working professionals, students and families alike. The colony's spine is the Malviya Nagar Main Market, one of the area's oldest shopping streets, with Malviya Nagar Metro Station on the Yellow Line at its edge making daily commutes easy. Saket adjoins to the south, which puts Select Citywalk and the mall belt, along with Max Super Speciality Hospital, within a few minutes of most homes. Hauz Khas lies across the Outer Ring Road to the north and Pushp Vihar to the south-east, while the old settlements of Begumpur and Khirki Extension sit along the colony's edges and supply much of the area's domestic workforce. Households here typically want part-time maids and cooks on tight morning slots that fit office and metro timings.
malviya-nagar.commuteNotes: Malviya Nagar Metro Station on the Yellow Line serves the colony directly, and helpers commonly walk in from Khirki Extension and Begumpur along its edges.
malviya-nagar.housingNotes: Dense builder floors with individual landlords dominate, so society gate passes are rarely needed; a few group-housing pockets nearby keep gate registers, but most homes arrange help directly.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Malviya Nagar do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Saket, Hauz Khas, Pushp Vihar and Green Park are all nearby and covered by the same helper network. Pockets such as Shivalik and Khirki Extension along the colony's edges are also within reach.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Malviya Nagar service cover?
localFaqs.a: Malviya Nagar falls under pincode 110017. Neighbouring Saket carries its own pincode, but homes on both sides are served by the same nearby helper pool.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Malviya Nagar need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Most homes are builder floors with individual landlords, so no formal pass is needed and entry is arranged directly with the household. Helpers living in adjacent Khirki Extension and Begumpur usually walk to work.

kalkaji.localIntro: Kalkaji, under pincode 110019, mixes DDA-built flats, plotted houses and busy market blocks, making it one of South Delhi's most varied residential pockets. The colony takes its name from the historic Kalkaji Mandir, and the Lotus Temple's gardens sit directly alongside, while Nehru Place — one of Delhi's biggest commercial and IT hardware hubs — adjoins the northern edge and brings a constant flow of office-goers. Kalkaji Mandir Metro Station, an interchange between the Violet and Magenta lines, plus the Nehru Place and Govindpuri stations, keep connectivity strong on every side. Chittaranjan Park and Greater Kailash II lie to the west, Okhla to the east and East of Kailash just beyond Nehru Place. Households range from government-flat families to professionals in rebuilt builder floors, and most hire part-time help for cleaning and cooking; the dense Govindpuri settlement next door is where a large share of local domestic helpers live.
kalkaji.commuteNotes: Kalkaji Mandir (a Violet-Magenta interchange), Nehru Place and Govindpuri metro stations ring the colony, with buses along the Outer Ring Road. Most helpers walk across from adjacent Govindpuri.
kalkaji.housingNotes: DDA flat blocks and plotted builder floors sit side by side; some DDA pockets follow RWA gate norms, but formal society passes are rare compared with gated townships.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Kalkaji do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Greater Kailash, East of Kailash, Okhla and New Friends Colony are all nearby and use the same helper network. The Nehru Place office hub adjoining Kalkaji is covered too.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Kalkaji service cover?
localFaqs.a: Kalkaji falls under pincode 110019, taking in the DDA blocks and plotted lanes around Kalkaji Mandir. Neighbouring Okhla is covered under 110020 and 110025.

localFaqs.q: Where do most domestic helpers in Kalkaji live?
localFaqs.a: A large share of helpers serving Kalkaji live in the adjacent Govindpuri settlement and walk to work. Others arrive via the Kalkaji Mandir or Govindpuri metro stations on the Violet Line.

chanakyapuri.localIntro: Chanakyapuri, Delhi's Diplomatic Enclave under pincode 110021, is unlike any other locality in the city: wide avenues along Shanti Path lined with embassies and high commissions, large independent bungalows, diplomatic residences and pockets of government housing. Households here are typically diplomatic families, senior officials and long-posted professionals, many running full households with cooks and full-time domestic staff rather than hourly help. Nehru Park anchors the enclave's green space and draws morning walkers year-round, the National Rail Museum sits within the enclave, and The Ashok hotel and the Santushti shopping complex are local fixtures. R.K. Puram adjoins to the south, Sarojini Nagar's government colonies and market lie to the south-east, and Delhi Cantt spreads to the west. Staffing here often involves gate protocols and verification formalities stricter than in regular colonies, and demand leans towards experienced cooks, housekeepers and nannies comfortable working in large single-family homes.
chanakyapuri.commuteNotes: There is no metro station inside the enclave itself; staff typically arrive by bus along Shanti Path and Ring Road, or from Pink Line stations towards Bhikaji Cama Place and the South Campus side. Many helpers live close by in the enclave's camps and staff quarters.
chanakyapuri.housingNotes: Large bungalows, diplomatic residences and government quarters dominate; staff typically undergo stricter verification, and embassy or government premises follow formal gate and pass procedures.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Chanakyapuri service cover?
localFaqs.a: Chanakyapuri falls under pincode 110021, covering the Diplomatic Enclave's residential avenues and government housing pockets. Neighbouring R.K. Puram is covered separately under 110022 and 110066.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Chanakyapuri need special entry clearances?
localFaqs.a: Homes in the Diplomatic Enclave often require identity checks and gate formalities stricter than in regular colonies, especially in embassy and government premises. Households should register their helper with the premises' security where applicable.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Chanakyapuri do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: R.K. Puram, Sarojini Nagar, Delhi Cantt and Vasant Vihar are all nearby and covered by the same helper network. Many helpers serving the enclave live locally in settlements such as Sanjay Camp.

rk-puram.localIntro: R.K. Puram, spread across pincodes 110022 and 110066, is one of Delhi's largest government housing colonies, its numbered sectors filled with Central Government quarters alongside pockets of private flats and sector markets. Households are predominantly government-employee families, many with elderly parents at home, which keeps demand steady for daily cleaning help, cooks and elder-care support. Delhi Public School R.K. Puram, one of the country's best-known schools, sits inside the colony, the Sangam Courtyard retail and dining complex is a local hub, and the Bhikaji Cama Place office district adjoins the north-eastern edge. R.K. Puram and Munirka stations on the Magenta Line and Bhikaji Cama Place on the Pink Line cover the metro connections. Munirka lies immediately south, Vasant Vihar to the west and Safdarjung Enclave to the north-east; helpers commonly walk in from Munirka village and the Mohammadpur settlement beside Bhikaji Cama Place.
rk-puram.commuteNotes: R.K. Puram and Munirka stations on the Magenta Line and Bhikaji Cama Place on the Pink Line serve different sectors, with DTC buses on the Ring Road. Helpers often walk in from Munirka village and Mohammadpur.
rk-puram.housingNotes: Government quarters arranged in numbered sectors rather than private societies; entry is straightforward, though households often prefer verified, long-term help given transferable postings.

localFaqs.q: Which pincodes does R.K. Puram service cover?
localFaqs.a: R.K. Puram is covered under pincodes 110022 and 110066, spanning its numbered government-housing sectors. Adjacent Munirka and Safdarjung Enclave fall under their own pincodes but share the same helper pool.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near R.K. Puram do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Munirka, Vasant Vihar, Safdarjung Enclave and Sarojini Nagar are all adjacent and served by the same network. The Bhikaji Cama Place side of the colony is covered as well.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers need gate passes in R.K. Puram's government quarters?
localFaqs.a: The sectors are government housing rather than gated private societies, so formal society passes are not the norm and households manage entry directly. Many families still prefer identity-verified helpers since postings are transferable and staff changes are common.

lajpat-nagar.localIntro: Lajpat Nagar, under pincode 110024, is best known for its Central Market, one of Delhi's busiest shopping destinations, but its four residential parts are equally lively — dense builder floors housing long-settled trading families, working professionals and a sizeable community of international residents. Amar Colony Market in Lajpat Nagar IV adds a second commercial hub, and Moolchand Hospital sits at the colony's Ring Road corner. Lajpat Nagar Metro Station is an interchange between the Violet and Pink lines, which makes the area one of South Delhi's best-connected addresses for residents and domestic helpers alike. Defence Colony adjoins directly across the Ring Road side, Jangpura lies to the north and East of Kailash to the south-west. Flats here are compact and stacked, so most households hire part-time maids and cooks on fixed one-to-two-hour slots, and buildings generally have straightforward entry compared with gated towers.
lajpat-nagar.commuteNotes: Lajpat Nagar Metro Station, an interchange of the Violet and Pink lines, plus Ring Road buses, make this one of the easiest South Delhi colonies for helpers to reach.
lajpat-nagar.housingNotes: Stacked builder floors with individual owners are the norm, so there are no society formalities; homes are compact, which keeps most engagements to part-time slots.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Lajpat Nagar service cover?
localFaqs.a: Lajpat Nagar falls under pincode 110024, which it shares with neighbouring Defence Colony. Coverage spans Lajpat Nagar parts I to IV, including Amar Colony.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Lajpat Nagar do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Defence Colony, Jangpura, East of Kailash and Andrews Ganj are all close by and served by the same helper pool. Helpers often take up homes in two or three of these colonies in a single day.

localFaqs.q: How do helpers usually reach homes in Lajpat Nagar?
localFaqs.a: The Lajpat Nagar Metro Station interchange on the Violet and Pink lines brings helpers in from across the city, and Ring Road buses add another option. Builder-floor buildings here have straightforward entry, so fixed part-time slots are easy to keep.

defence-colony.localIntro: Defence Colony, pincode 110024, remains one of South Delhi's classic plotted neighbourhoods, laid out in lettered blocks around a central market well known for its restaurants and cafes. The dominant housing form is the independent house, though many plots have been rebuilt as spacious builder floors, and residents are typically established families, retired officers and senior professionals, with a noticeable expatriate presence. Moolchand Hospital stands nearby on Ring Road, Lajpat Nagar's Central Market is directly across, and Jangpura Metro Station on the Violet Line is the closest metro point for most blocks. Lajpat Nagar adjoins to the east, Jangpura to the north and Andrews Ganj towards the western side. Households here often want full-day or long-shift domestic help — cooks, housekeepers and elder-care attendants — and the adjacent Kotla Mubarakpur village has long been the main residential base for domestic workers serving the colony.
defence-colony.commuteNotes: Jangpura and Lajpat Nagar metro stations on the Violet Line flank the colony, with buses along Ring Road. Most helpers walk in from adjacent Kotla Mubarakpur.
defence-colony.housingNotes: Independent houses and roomy builder floors on large plots; many households employ full-day or live-in staff and handle verification individually rather than through society gates.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Defence Colony service cover?
localFaqs.a: Defence Colony falls under pincode 110024, shared with neighbouring Lajpat Nagar. Coverage takes in the colony's lettered blocks around the central market.

localFaqs.q: Where do most domestic helpers in Defence Colony live?
localFaqs.a: The adjacent Kotla Mubarakpur village has long been the main residential base for domestic workers serving Defence Colony, and most helpers walk in from there. Others arrive via the Jangpura or Lajpat Nagar metro stations on the Violet Line.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Defence Colony do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Lajpat Nagar, Jangpura, Andrews Ganj and Nizamuddin are all close by and covered by the same helper network. Households needing full-day cooks or elder-care attendants can draw from the same nearby pool.

new-friends-colony.localIntro: New Friends Colony, under pincode 110025, is a large plotted colony of generous independent houses arranged in lettered blocks, long favoured by established business families, senior professionals and diplomats. The Community Centre is the colony's social hub, ringed by restaurants and offices, and The Suryaa hotel stands at its edge; Jamia Millia Islamia's campus and Holy Family Hospital adjoin the colony on the Okhla side, adding a steady academic and medical population to the neighbourhood. Ashram Chowk connects the area to Ring Road and Mathura Road traffic, with the Ashram Pink Line and Sukhdev Vihar Magenta Line stations the nearest metro points. Okhla lies directly south-east, Kalkaji across the Mathura Road belt and Sarita Vihar further down towards the industrial phases. Large homes here typically employ full-time or full-day staff — cooks, housekeepers and drivers — and many domestic workers serving the colony live in the adjacent Taimoor Nagar settlement.
new-friends-colony.commuteNotes: Ashram on the Pink Line and Sukhdev Vihar on the Magenta Line are the nearest metro stations, with buses along Mathura Road. Many helpers walk in from the adjacent Taimoor Nagar settlement.
new-friends-colony.housingNotes: Large independent homes on big plots, many with staff quarters, so full-time and live-in arrangements are common and entry is managed by each household.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does New Friends Colony service cover?
localFaqs.a: New Friends Colony falls under pincode 110025, which it shares with part of the neighbouring Okhla belt. Coverage spans the colony's lettered blocks around the Community Centre.

localFaqs.q: Are live-in helpers available for homes in New Friends Colony?
localFaqs.a: Yes — many houses here are large plots with staff quarters, so live-in and full-day arrangements for cooks and housekeepers are common. Part-time help is also available from nearby settlements such as Taimoor Nagar.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near New Friends Colony do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Okhla, East of Kailash, Kalkaji and Sarita Vihar are all nearby and covered by the same helper network. The Jamia Millia Islamia and Holy Family Hospital belt adjoining the colony is included too.

okhla.localIntro: Okhla, spanning pincodes 110020 and 110025, covers a broad belt of south-east Delhi that includes the Okhla Industrial Area's phases, the residential stretches around Jamia Nagar and Okhla Vihar, and major institutional campuses. Jamia Millia Islamia university shapes much of the area's character, bringing student, faculty and staff households, while Holy Family Hospital is the major medical landmark. Housing is genuinely mixed — walk-up apartments and dense family homes in the residential pockets, with offices, factories and media houses concentrated in the industrial phases; the Okhla Bird Sanctuary lies at the area's eastern edge near the Yamuna. The Magenta Line runs through with stations at Jamia Millia Islamia, Sukhdev Vihar and Okhla NSIC, keeping commutes practical for residents and helpers alike. New Friends Colony adjoins to the north-west, Sarita Vihar to the south and Kalkaji across the Mathura Road side; households here typically hire part-time help for cleaning and cooking, often from within the surrounding residential settlements.
okhla.commuteNotes: The Magenta Line's Jamia Millia Islamia, Sukhdev Vihar and Okhla NSIC stations run through the area. Most helpers live within the surrounding residential pockets and reach homes on foot or by shared auto.
okhla.housingNotes: A genuine mix — walk-up apartments and dense family housing in the residential pockets, with a handful of societies near the industrial phases; most homes arrange help directly without gate-pass systems.

localFaqs.q: Which pincodes does Okhla service cover?
localFaqs.a: Okhla is covered under pincodes 110020 and 110025, spanning the industrial phases and the residential belt around Jamia Nagar. Neighbouring New Friends Colony also falls under 110025.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Okhla do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: New Friends Colony, Sarita Vihar, Kalkaji and Badarpur are all nearby and served by the same helper network. Homes around the Jamia Millia Islamia campus are covered within Okhla itself.

localFaqs.q: How do helpers usually reach homes in Okhla?
localFaqs.a: Most helpers live in the dense residential pockets around Jamia Nagar and Okhla Vihar and walk or take a shared auto to nearby homes. The Magenta Line's Jamia Millia Islamia, Sukhdev Vihar and Okhla NSIC stations cover longer commutes.

mehrauli.localIntro: Mehrauli, under pincode 110030, is one of Delhi's oldest continuously inhabited areas, wrapped around the Qutub Minar and the sprawling Mehrauli Archaeological Park. The locality blends a historic village core of narrow lanes and independent houses with newer builder floors, urbanised village pockets and, towards the outskirts, farmhouse estates — a genuinely mixed housing stock that shapes very different domestic-help needs street by street. The Garden of Five Senses lies on the Saket side, Ahinsa Sthal marks the approach near the Qutub complex, and Qutab Minar Metro Station on the Yellow Line connects the area to the rest of the city. Chhatarpur adjoins to the south with its farmhouse belt and temple complex, Saket and its malls lie to the east, and Vasant Kunj sits across the ridge to the west. Households range from old Mehrauli families in ancestral homes to professionals in newly built floors, with steady demand for part-time cleaning and cooking help, much of it met locally from within Mehrauli's own settlements.
mehrauli.commuteNotes: Qutab Minar Metro Station on the Yellow Line and buses along the Mehrauli-Badarpur and Mehrauli-Gurgaon roads connect the area. Many helpers live within Mehrauli's own village lanes and walk to work.
mehrauli.housingNotes: Village-core houses, rebuilt builder floors and outlying farmhouse estates make the stock highly varied; farmhouses often want live-in staff, while village and colony homes prefer part-time help.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Mehrauli service cover?
localFaqs.a: Mehrauli falls under pincode 110030, covering the village core near the Qutub Minar as well as the newer residential pockets around it. Neighbouring Chhatarpur and Saket carry their own pincodes but share the same helper network.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Mehrauli do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Chhatarpur, Saket, Vasant Kunj and Pushp Vihar are all nearby and covered by the same helper pool. Coverage runs from the lanes around the Mehrauli Archaeological Park out towards the farmhouse belt.

localFaqs.q: Can farmhouses around Mehrauli get live-in help?
localFaqs.a: Yes — the farmhouse estates towards the Chhatarpur side commonly employ live-in cooks and housekeepers, and such placements are supported here. Homes in the village core and colony pockets more often take part-time morning or evening slots.

greater-kailash.localIntro: Greater Kailash, split into the well-known GK 1 and GK 2 blocks under pincode 110048, is one of South Delhi's most established residential colonies. The housing stock is dominated by builder floors — original plotted kothis rebuilt into three- and four-storey family floors — so most households run as independent family units rather than tower societies. Daily life centres on the M Block markets of both GK 1 and GK 2, with the Lotus Temple a short drive away on the Kalkaji side. Kailash Colony Metro Station on the Violet Line and the Greater Kailash station on the Magenta Line anchor connectivity for commuting workers. Households here are a mix of long-settled families, senior citizens living in ancestral floors, and professionals renting newer builder floors, so both full-day and part-time domestic help are in steady demand. East of Kailash, Kalkaji and Lajpat Nagar adjoin the colony, and helpers from the neighbouring Zamrudpur and Chirag Delhi villages work across its blocks.
greater-kailash.commuteNotes: Helpers reach Greater Kailash via Kailash Colony Metro Station on the Violet Line or the Greater Kailash Magenta Line station, and many walk in from the adjacent Zamrudpur and Chirag Delhi villages. Buses along the Outer Ring Road also serve the GK 2 side.
greater-kailash.housingNotes: The colony is mostly builder floors on private plots, so households usually manage their own timings and door access rather than society gate passes; a few blocks with RWA gates may ask visiting helpers to sign an entry register.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Greater Kailash do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Alongside GK 1 and GK 2, service coverage extends to adjoining colonies such as East of Kailash, Kalkaji, Lajpat Nagar and Andrews Ganj. Helpers working in Greater Kailash often take up households in these neighbouring areas too.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Greater Kailash need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Most of Greater Kailash is builder floors on private plots, so entry is managed by the household itself. In blocks where the RWA has gated the lane, helpers may need to sign a visitor register at the gate, which the household can arrange on day one.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Greater Kailash service cover?
localFaqs.a: Greater Kailash falls under pincode 110048, which covers both the GK 1 and GK 2 blocks. Households around the M Block markets and towards Kailash Colony Metro Station are all within this coverage.

andrews-ganj.localIntro: Andrews Ganj sits between South Extension Part II and the Siri Fort belt under pincode 110049, a compact pocket that mixes government housing blocks with the Hudco Place apartment complex and adjoining private homes. Households range from serving and retired government employees in the older quarters to professionals and families in the Hudco Place flats, which keeps demand steady for both part-time cleaning help and full-day cooks. Ansal Plaza, one of Delhi's earliest malls, stands right beside the colony on Khel Gaon Marg, while the South Extension Part II market and Siri Fort Auditorium are within easy reach for shopping and evening outings. The mixed housing profile means domestic help arrangements vary: gated apartment entry registers at Hudco Place, and more informal, flexible timings in the older government blocks. Defence Colony and Lajpat Nagar lie towards the east, Greater Kailash to the south-east, and Hauz Khas and Green Park across Aurobindo Marg to the west.
andrews-ganj.commuteNotes: Buses along the Ring Road and August Kranti Marg are the main way helpers reach Andrews Ganj, with the South Extension metro station on the Pink Line a short walk from the colony's northern side.
andrews-ganj.housingNotes: Housing is a mix of government quarters and the gated Hudco Place complex; Hudco Place towers typically require helper entry registration at the gate, while the government blocks and private homes manage access informally.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Andrews Ganj do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Coverage around Andrews Ganj includes Defence Colony, Lajpat Nagar, Greater Kailash and the Hauz Khas–Green Park belt. Many helpers serving South Extension Part II households also take up work in Andrews Ganj since the areas adjoin each other.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Andrews Ganj need gate passes?
localFaqs.a: In the gated Hudco Place apartment complex, helpers are usually registered at the gate and issued an entry pass by the society office. In the government quarters and private homes of Andrews Ganj, entry is handled directly by the household.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Andrews Ganj service cover?
localFaqs.a: Andrews Ganj falls under pincode 110049. Households in Hudco Place, the government housing blocks and the lanes near Ansal Plaza are all covered within this pincode.

vasant-vihar.localIntro: Vasant Vihar, under pincode 110057, is one of South Delhi's most exclusive residential colonies, laid out in lettered blocks of large independent houses and bungalows. Residents include long-settled business families, senior professionals, expatriates and diplomatic households, and many homes keep full-day or live-in domestic staff alongside part-time cleaners and cooks. The Basant Lok community centre with its Priya cinema complex is the colony's main social and shopping hub, and Modern School Vasant Vihar is a well-known institution on its edge. Vasant Vihar Metro Station on the Magenta Line sits along the Outer Ring Road side of the colony, making commutes straightforward for working households and helpers alike. Elderly parents living with families are common here, so elder-care and cook roles see steady demand. Munirka lies just across the Outer Ring Road, with R.K. Puram to the north-east and Vasant Kunj to the south; most helpers walk in from Munirka village and the adjacent Kusumpur Pahari settlement.
vasant-vihar.commuteNotes: Vasant Vihar Metro Station on the Magenta Line serves the colony directly, and many helpers simply walk across from Munirka village or Kusumpur Pahari, both adjacent to the colony.
vasant-vihar.housingNotes: The stock is almost entirely large independent houses and bungalows, so households set their own timings and door access without society formalities; homes with private security may keep their own visitor log.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Vasant Vihar do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Service around Vasant Vihar extends to Munirka, R.K. Puram, Vasant Kunj and the Shanti Niketan–Anand Niketan side towards Chanakyapuri. Helpers based in Munirka village commonly work across all of these adjoining areas.

localFaqs.q: Where do domestic helpers working in Vasant Vihar usually come from?
localFaqs.a: Most helpers in Vasant Vihar live in Munirka village or the Kusumpur Pahari settlement, both within walking distance of the colony's blocks. This keeps morning reporting times reliable even for early cook shifts.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Vasant Vihar service cover?
localFaqs.a: Vasant Vihar falls under pincode 110057, covering all its lettered blocks around Basant Lok Market. Households near the Vasant Vihar Metro Station and Modern School are within this coverage.

pushp-vihar.localIntro: Pushp Vihar is a planned DDA neighbourhood under pincode 110062, its numbered sectors filled with low-rise apartment blocks that sit alongside the adjoining Madangir resettlement colony, giving the area a genuinely mixed housing character. Households are largely salaried families and working professionals in the DDA flats, many of them double-income homes that rely on part-time help for cleaning and cooking. The Saket District Centre with Select Citywalk lies just to the north, the Saket Court Complex and Max Hospital Saket are on the Press Enclave Road side, and Batra Hospital is close by towards the Mehrauli-Badarpur Road. This puts hospitals, courts and malls — all large employers — at the doorstep, adding demand from professionals who keep long work hours. Saket and Malviya Nagar adjoin Pushp Vihar to the north, with Sangam Vihar towards the east via Khanpur. Helpers overwhelmingly come from the neighbouring Madangir and Dr. Ambedkar Nagar settlements, often on foot.
pushp-vihar.commuteNotes: Most helpers walk in from the adjacent Madangir and Dr. Ambedkar Nagar settlements; for longer commutes, Saket Metro Station on the Yellow Line and buses along Press Enclave Road and the Mehrauli-Badarpur Road serve the area.
pushp-vihar.housingNotes: The DDA sector blocks are low-rise walk-up flats, usually without formal society gate systems, so households coordinate timings directly; a few gated pockets may keep a register at the sector gate.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Pushp Vihar do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Coverage around Pushp Vihar includes Saket, Malviya Nagar and the Khanpur side towards Sangam Vihar. Helpers based in Madangir commonly work across Pushp Vihar's sectors and these adjoining areas.

localFaqs.q: Where do helpers working in Pushp Vihar usually live?
localFaqs.a: Most helpers come from Madangir and Dr. Ambedkar Nagar, which directly adjoin Pushp Vihar's sectors. Walking distances are short, which makes early-morning and multiple-household shifts practical.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Pushp Vihar service cover?
localFaqs.a: Pushp Vihar falls under pincode 110062, covering its DDA sectors and the adjoining Madangir side. Households near the Saket Court Complex and Press Enclave Road edge are within this coverage.

east-of-kailash.localIntro: East of Kailash, under pincode 110065, is a settled South Delhi colony organised into lettered blocks of builder floors — plotted homes rebuilt into multi-storey family floors that now dominate the housing stock. The ISKCON Temple on Hare Krishna Hill rises inside the colony itself, the Lotus Temple sits just beyond its southern edge, and the Nehru Place commercial hub is a short distance away, bringing a daily flow of office-goers through the area. Kailash Colony Metro Station on the Violet Line serves the colony's western side. Households are a blend of families who have lived here for decades, elderly residents in older floors, and professionals renting newer builder floors, which keeps demand high for part-time cleaning, cooking and elder-care support. The urban village of Garhi lies within the colony and is where many local helpers live. Kalkaji, Greater Kailash and Lajpat Nagar adjoin East of Kailash, with New Friends Colony across the Mathura Road side.
east-of-kailash.commuteNotes: Kailash Colony Metro Station on the Violet Line is the nearest metro, with Nehru Place station also close by; many helpers walk to work from Garhi village inside the colony.
east-of-kailash.housingNotes: Builder floors on private plots dominate, so households control their own entry and timings; blocks with RWA gates may ask helpers to sign a simple register, but formal society passes are uncommon.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near East of Kailash do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Coverage extends to the adjoining colonies of Kalkaji, Greater Kailash and Lajpat Nagar, and across to New Friends Colony. Helpers living in Garhi village often work in several of these areas in a single day.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in East of Kailash need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Most of East of Kailash is builder floors where the household manages entry directly, so no society pass is needed. Where an RWA has gated a block, helpers may sign a visitor register at the gate.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does East of Kailash service cover?
localFaqs.a: East of Kailash falls under pincode 110065, covering its lettered blocks around the ISKCON Temple. Homes towards the Lotus Temple and Kailash Colony Metro Station side are within this coverage.

munirka.localIntro: Munirka, under pincode 110067, pairs the dense lanes of old Munirka village with the planned DDA flats beside it, producing a mixed housing profile that houses students, young professionals and settled families side by side. Jawaharlal Nehru University lies directly across the road, and IIT Delhi is a short ride down the Outer Ring Road, so rented rooms and shared flats for students form a big part of the area's rental market. Munirka Metro Station on the Magenta Line sits on the Outer Ring Road edge, and the village market keeps daily needs close at hand. Households in the DDA flats — many of them working couples and families — take regular part-time help for cleaning and cooking, while student households typically want short, fixed-time visits. Vasant Vihar is just across the Outer Ring Road, with R.K. Puram to the north and Hauz Khas towards the east. Most helpers live within Munirka village itself or in nearby Kusumpur Pahari.
munirka.commuteNotes: Munirka Metro Station on the Magenta Line and the busy Outer Ring Road bus corridor serve the area directly; a large share of helpers live within Munirka village and simply walk to nearby flats.
munirka.housingNotes: The DDA flats are walk-up blocks with light gating at most, while village homes are independent multi-storey buildings; in both, timings and access are agreed directly with the household rather than through a society office.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Munirka do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Coverage around Munirka includes Vasant Vihar across the Outer Ring Road, R.K. Puram, and the Hauz Khas–Safdarjung Enclave belt. Helpers living in Munirka village routinely work across these adjoining colonies.

localFaqs.q: Can students near JNU and IIT Delhi book part-time help in Munirka?
localFaqs.a: Yes. Munirka's rental market around JNU and IIT Delhi includes many student households, and short fixed-time cleaning or cooking visits are a common arrangement here. Timings are agreed directly with the helper.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Munirka service cover?
localFaqs.a: Munirka falls under pincode 110067, covering both the DDA flats and Munirka village. Homes near the Munirka Metro Station and the village market are within this coverage.

saket.localIntro: Saket combines planned residential blocks and builder floors with the Saket District Centre, home to Select Citywalk and DLF Avenue, two of South Delhi's busiest malls. The service belt here carries pincode 110068, taking in the IGNOU side around the colony's southern edge — the area's alternate name, the IGNOU belt, comes from the university's main campus nearby. Max Hospital Saket and the mall complex employ large numbers of professionals, and households in the area skew towards working couples and families who need dependable part-time or full-day help. Saket Metro Station on the Yellow Line anchors the area's connectivity, and the Garden of Five Senses lies towards the Saidul Ajaib side. Housing is genuinely mixed: DDA blocks, private builder floors and urban-village pockets sit close together, so helper arrangements range from gate registers to direct doorstep timings. Malviya Nagar and Pushp Vihar adjoin Saket, with Mehrauli to the west; most helpers come from the neighbouring Hauz Rani and Khirki Extension settlements.
saket.commuteNotes: Saket Metro Station on the Yellow Line and buses along Press Enclave Marg and the Mehrauli-Badarpur Road serve the area; many helpers walk in from Hauz Rani and Khirki Extension, which sit right beside Saket's blocks.
saket.housingNotes: DDA blocks, builder floors and village pockets sit side by side, so most households manage helper access directly; the gated apartment pockets keep an entry register or pass system at the gate.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Saket do you also serve?

localFaqs.q: Where do helpers working in Saket usually live?

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Saket service area cover?

vasant-kunj.localIntro: Vasant Kunj, spread across pincodes 110070 and 110072, is a large planned neighbourhood of DDA sectors and pockets — apartment blocks arranged in gated clusters that make it one of South Delhi's biggest concentrations of flat-dwelling households. Residents are predominantly working professionals and families, many in double-income homes that depend on part-time or full-day domestic help. The mall cluster on Nelson Mandela Marg — DLF Promenade, DLF Emporio and Ambience Mall — is the area's best-known landmark strip, and Fortis Hospital Vasant Kunj serves the neighbourhood from within it. The urban villages of Masoodpur and Kishangarh sit inside and beside Vasant Kunj, and they are where a large share of the area's helpers live, keeping walking commutes short despite the neighbourhood's size. Vasant Vihar lies to the north, Mahipalpur to the west towards the airport side, and Mehrauli and Chhatarpur towards the east and south-east.
vasant-kunj.commuteNotes: There is no metro station inside most of Vasant Kunj; Chhatarpur on the Yellow Line and Vasant Vihar on the Magenta Line are the closest stations, and buses run along Nelson Mandela Marg. Many helpers walk from Masoodpur and Kishangarh, which adjoin the sectors.
vasant-kunj.housingNotes: Housing is overwhelmingly gated apartment pockets, so helpers typically need gate entry registration and, in many societies, a maid pass issued through the RWA or facility office before starting work.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Vasant Kunj need society gate passes?
localFaqs.a: Yes, in most cases. Vasant Kunj's DDA pockets and apartment societies are gated, and helpers are registered at the gate with an entry pass arranged through the society office. This is usually completed on the first working day.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Vasant Kunj do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Coverage extends to Vasant Vihar, Munirka, Mahipalpur and the Mehrauli–Chhatarpur side. Helpers living in Masoodpur and Kishangarh commonly work across Vasant Kunj's sectors and these adjoining areas.

localFaqs.q: Which pincodes does Vasant Kunj service cover?
localFaqs.a: Vasant Kunj service covers pincodes 110070 and 110072, taking in its sectors and pockets. Households near the Nelson Mandela Marg mall strip and Fortis Hospital are within this coverage.

chhatarpur.localIntro: Chhatarpur, under pincode 110074, stretches from the famous Chhatarpur Mandir complex out towards Delhi's southern edge, and its housing is genuinely mixed: farmhouse estates along the internal roads, the old village settlement, and dense builder-floor colonies in Chhatarpur Extension. This spread produces two very different kinds of demand — farmhouses and large independent homes often keep full-day or live-in staff, while families in the Extension's builder floors typically take part-time help for cleaning and cooking. Chhatarpur Metro Station on the Yellow Line connects the area along the Mehrauli-Gurgaon corridor, with the Qutub Minar just north in Mehrauli and the Garden of Five Senses towards the Saket side. Many of the area's helpers live within Chhatarpur Extension itself, keeping commutes short. Mehrauli adjoins Chhatarpur to the north, Saket lies to the north-east, and Vasant Kunj is across the ridge to the north-west.
chhatarpur.commuteNotes: Chhatarpur Metro Station on the Yellow Line is the main transit point, with buses and shared autos running along Chhatarpur Road towards the Mandir and the farmhouse lanes; many helpers live within Chhatarpur Extension and travel locally.
chhatarpur.housingNotes: Farmhouses and independent homes manage staff access privately and often prefer full-day or live-in arrangements, while the builder-floor colonies of Chhatarpur Extension work on flexible, directly agreed part-time timings.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Chhatarpur do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Coverage around Chhatarpur includes Mehrauli, Saket and Vasant Kunj, extending down the MG Road corridor towards Arjun Garh. Helpers based in Chhatarpur Extension often serve households across this belt.

localFaqs.q: Do farmhouses in Chhatarpur get live-in help?

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Chhatarpur service cover?

The Indraprastha Apollo Hospital stands at the colony's edge on Mathura Road and is a major local employer, alongside the offices of the Jasola District Centre next door — both feed steady demand from professional households for part-time and full-day help. Sarita Vihar Metro Station on the Violet Line serves the area directly, and Kalindi Kunj Park lies towards the Yamuna side. Because the pockets are gated, helpers here are usually registered at pocket gates before starting work. The adjoining Madanpur Khadar settlement is where most of the area's domestic workers live, a short walk from the pockets. Okhla adjoins Sarita Vihar to the north-west, Badarpur lies down Mathura Road to the south, and New Friends Colony is further up the same corridor.
sarita-vihar.commuteNotes: Sarita Vihar Metro Station on the Violet Line and buses along Mathura Road serve the colony; most helpers walk in from the adjacent Madanpur Khadar settlement.
sarita-vihar.housingNotes: The DDA pockets are gated apartment clusters, so helpers generally sign an entry register or carry a pocket gate pass; timings inside flats are then agreed directly with the household.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Sarita Vihar need gate passes?

localFaqs.q: Where do helpers working in Sarita Vihar usually live?

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Sarita Vihar service cover?

sangam-vihar.localIntro: Sangam Vihar, under pincode 110080, is one of Delhi's largest and densest residential settlements, built almost entirely of independent multi-storey houses packed along narrow numbered blocks off the Mehrauli-Badarpur Road. Households are working families — many with both adults employed — and demand here leans towards affordable part-time help for cleaning and cooking rather than full-day staff. The historic Tughlakabad Fort spreads along the area's eastern side, Batra Hospital is close by on the MB Road, and the busy Khanpur crossing is the main junction connecting the blocks to the rest of South Delhi. Because most homes are self-built independent houses, there are no society gates or passes; helpers and households settle timings at the doorstep. Many helpers live within Sangam Vihar's own blocks or in the adjoining Deoli and Tigri settlements. Pushp Vihar lies to the west via Khanpur, Badarpur to the east past Tughlakabad, and Saket further along Press Enclave Road.
sangam-vihar.commuteNotes: Buses and shared autos along the Mehrauli-Badarpur Road are the main links, with the Khanpur crossing as the key junction; most helpers live within Sangam Vihar or walk in from adjoining Deoli and Tigri.
sangam-vihar.housingNotes: The area is wall-to-wall independent houses without society gating, so access and timings are agreed directly at the door; multi-floor homes often split help between floors occupied by different family units.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Sangam Vihar do you also serve?

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Sangam Vihar need gate passes?

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Sangam Vihar service cover?

sarojini-nagar.localIntro: Sarojini Nagar, under pincode 110023, is best known city-wide for the Sarojini Nagar Market, but the locality itself is a central-government housing colony whose quarters house serving and retired officials and their families. Parts of the colony have been taken up for phased redevelopment into new government housing towers, so the residential stock today is a mix of older low-rise quarters and newer blocks. Dilli Haat and INA Market sit just across the Ring Road side, Safdarjung Airport lies to the east, and Sarojini Nagar Metro Station on the Pink Line puts the area on the metro map with the INA interchange one stop away. Households here are typically single-family government quarters, including many with elderly parents, and part-time cleaning and cooking help is the standard arrangement. Chanakyapuri adjoins the colony to the north-west, R.K. Puram lies to the south, and Safdarjung Enclave and Green Park are towards the south-east.
sarojini-nagar.commuteNotes: Sarojini Nagar Metro Station on the Pink Line serves the colony directly, with the INA interchange linking to the Yellow Line one stop away; Ring Road buses also stop along the market side.
sarojini-nagar.housingNotes: Government quarters and newer redeveloped blocks make up the stock; older quarters manage helper entry informally, while the new towers follow gate registration similar to private societies.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Sarojini Nagar do you also serve?
localFaqs.a: Coverage around Sarojini Nagar includes Chanakyapuri, R.K. Puram and the Safdarjung Enclave–Green Park belt, along with the Lodi Road side. Helpers serving the INA and Dilli Haat stretch commonly work across these areas.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers in Sarojini Nagar need gate passes?
localFaqs.a: In the older government quarters, entry is managed informally by the household. In the newer redeveloped towers, helpers are registered at the gate much like in private gated societies, which the household can arrange before the first visit.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Sarojini Nagar service cover?
localFaqs.a: Sarojini Nagar falls under pincode 110023. Households in the government quarters around the Sarojini Nagar Market and towards the Pink Line metro station are within this coverage.

Households are predominantly working families, and the usual arrangement is part-time help for cleaning and cooking, with timings agreed directly at the doorstep since there are no society gates in most of the area. The Badarpur Border Metro Station on the Violet Line is the locality's main transit landmark, the Tughlakabad Fort spreads to the west, and the campus of the former Badarpur Thermal Power Station marks the area's eastern face along the highway. Helpers generally live locally, in Badarpur's own lanes or in the adjoining Molarband and Jaitpur settlements. Sarita Vihar lies up Mathura Road to the north, Sangam Vihar is to the west past Tughlakabad, and the Okhla belt is further along the same corridor.
badarpur.commuteNotes: The Violet Line serves the area through Badarpur Border and Tughlakabad stations, and buses run along Mathura Road; most helpers live locally in Badarpur, Molarband or Jaitpur and walk to work.
badarpur.housingNotes: The stock is almost entirely independent multi-storey houses without society gating, so households and helpers agree access and timings directly; flexible morning and evening slots are the norm.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Badarpur do you also serve?

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Badarpur service cover?

dwarka.localIntro: Dwarka is a planned DDA sub-city in south-west Delhi, laid out in numbered sectors across pincodes 110075 and 110078. Housing is dominated by gated cooperative group housing societies and apartment complexes, so most households are working professionals and families living behind secured gates with visitor-entry systems. The sub-city is well served by the Blue Line metro, with Vegas Mall in Sector 14 and Pacific D21 Mall near the Dwarka Sector 21 interchange station anchoring the retail side, while Netaji Subhas University of Technology in Sector 3 and Venkateshwar Hospital in Sector 18A anchor the institutional one. The Yashobhoomi convention centre in Sector 25 has added further activity on the airport-facing edge. Dwarka sits with Palam and Mahavir Enclave along its eastern side, Uttam Nagar and Janakpuri to the north-east, and Najafgarh and Chhawla towards the rural west, so domestic helpers move easily between these areas. For gated societies, helpers typically need police verification and a society entry pass, which residents arrange through the RWA or society office before the first working day.
dwarka.commuteNotes: The Blue Line runs through the sub-city with stations from Dwarka Mor to Dwarka Sector 21, and the Airport Express Line also stops at Sector 21; many helpers arrive by metro or come on foot or by cycle from adjacent areas such as Palam, Sagarpur and Kakrola.
dwarka.housingNotes: Housing is dominated by gated CGHS societies and apartment towers where helpers need police verification and society entry passes; RWAs and society offices keep gate records, so residents usually register a helper before the first visit.

localFaqs.q: Do maids and cooks in Dwarka need society gate passes?

localFaqs.q: Which pincodes does the Dwarka service area cover?

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Dwarka are also served?

delhi-cantt.localIntro: Delhi Cantt, pincode 110010, is a large cantonment area administered by the Cantonment Board and dominated by defence quarters, bungalows and institutional campuses rather than commercial towers. Households are largely serving and retired defence families, and daily life centres on established markets like Gopinath Bazaar and the cantonment's own Sadar Bazaar. Base Hospital Delhi Cantt and the Manekshaw Centre on Parade Road are prominent landmarks, while Delhi Cantt Railway Station connects the area to the wider rail network. Because much of the housing is official accommodation inside controlled-entry zones, domestic helpers usually go through identity checks and, in many pockets, need entry passes issued for the specific residential area, which households arrange in advance. Nangal Raya and Naraina adjoin the cantonment on its city side, Palam lies to the west, and R.K. Puram is a short distance away across Dhaula Kuan. Working hours in cantonment homes tend to follow structured routines, and helpers reaching the area rely on its bus corridors and the Magenta Line station at Sadar Bazaar Cantonment.
delhi-cantt.commuteNotes: Helpers usually arrive by bus along the cantonment's arterial roads or via the Sadar Bazaar Cantonment station on the Magenta Line; Delhi Cantt Railway Station also links the area to the rail network.
delhi-cantt.housingNotes: Most housing is defence quarters and bungalows inside controlled-entry zones, so helpers often need identity checks and area-specific entry passes; households typically arrange these before the first visit.

localFaqs.q: Do helpers need special entry passes to work in Delhi Cantt?

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Delhi Cantt service area cover?
localFaqs.a: Delhi Cantt service coverage corresponds to pincode 110010, which spans the cantonment's residential pockets around Gopinath Bazaar and Sadar Bazaar. Neighbouring Nangal Raya and Palam are covered under their own pincodes.

localFaqs.q: Which areas around Delhi Cantt are also served?
localFaqs.a: Coverage extends to adjoining areas including Nangal Raya, Naraina, Palam and R.K. Puram across Dhaula Kuan. Dwarka and Mahipalpur on the cantonment's western and southern sides are also close by.

mahipalpur.localIntro: Mahipalpur, pincode 110037, is a dense urban village on NH-48 right beside Indira Gandhi International Airport and the Aerocity hospitality district. The housing stock is mostly builder floors and multi-storey village homes packed along narrow lanes, with a heavy concentration of guest houses and hotels — the Radisson Blu Plaza on the highway is a familiar marker of the area. Many residents work in aviation, hotels and logistics connected to the airport, so households include shift-working professionals alongside long-settled village families, and demand for flexible morning and evening help is steady. The Delhi Aerocity station on the Airport Express Line is the closest metro point, and buses and shared autos run constantly along NH-48. Vasant Kunj rises immediately to the east, Rajokri lies further down the highway towards the Gurugram border, and Palam and Dwarka sit on the airport's other flank. Helpers serving Mahipalpur homes typically live in the village itself or in nearby Rangpuri, walking or taking short shared-auto rides, which makes part-time slots across the day easy to arrange.
mahipalpur.commuteNotes: Delhi Aerocity station on the Airport Express Line is the nearest metro point, and buses and shared autos run along NH-48; many helpers live within Mahipalpur village or nearby Rangpuri and reach homes on foot.
mahipalpur.housingNotes: The stock is dense builder floors and village homes without society gates; entry and timings are agreed directly with each household, and part-time slots across mornings and evenings are the usual pattern.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does Mahipalpur service cover?
localFaqs.a: Mahipalpur falls under pincode 110037, covering the village core and the lanes off NH-48 near the airport. Vasant Kunj and Palam next door have their own pincodes and locality pages.

localFaqs.q: Where do domestic helpers in Mahipalpur usually come from?
localFaqs.a: Most helpers live within Mahipalpur village itself or in nearby Rangpuri, so they reach homes on foot or by a short shared-auto ride. This makes part-time morning and evening slots straightforward to schedule.

localFaqs.q: Which areas near Mahipalpur are also served?
localFaqs.a: Nearby coverage includes Vasant Kunj, Rajokri, Palam and Delhi Cantt, with Dwarka a little further west. The NH-48 corridor and airport roads keep these areas closely connected.

rajokari.localIntro: Rajokri, pincode 110038, is an urban village on NH-48 near the Delhi–Gurugram border, familiar to commuters for the Rajokri flyover on the airport highway. The core is a traditional village settlement of independent houses, surrounded by a belt of farmhouses and newer builder floors, and households range from long-established village families to professionals who commute to Gurugram's office districts and to Aerocity. Indira Gandhi International Airport lies just up the highway, and Ambience Mall on the Gurugram side of the border is the closest large mall. Mahipalpur is the next settlement towards the airport, Vasant Kunj spreads across the ridge to the east, and the Arjun Garh–Aya Nagar belt sits further south along the ridge. There is no metro station inside Rajokri itself, so helpers typically rely on buses and shared autos along NH-48 or live within the village. Homes here tend to have flexible, informal working arrangements compared with gated societies, with entry and timings managed directly by the household rather than through a gate office.
rajokari.commuteNotes: There is no metro station within Rajokri; helpers rely on buses and shared autos along NH-48 or live within the village itself.
rajokari.housingNotes: Independent village houses and farmhouse plots dominate, with no society gate systems; households manage entry directly and timings tend to be flexible.

najafgarh.localIntro: Najafgarh is a large, self-contained township in outer south-west Delhi covering pincodes 110043 and 110073, historically a market town serving the surrounding villages. Housing is overwhelmingly independent plotted houses, many built over shops along dense bazaar streets, and households are typically multi-generational families rather than transient professionals. The area gained a direct metro link with the Grey Line, whose Najafgarh and Dhansa Bus Stand stations connect the town to Dwarka's Blue Line network, and the Najafgarh drain that skirts the town is a prominent local waterway. Rao Tula Ram Memorial Hospital at nearby Jaffarpur is the main government hospital serving this belt. Chhawla lies to the south-east on the road towards Dwarka, Dwarka sub-city itself is the nearest major apartment hub, and Uttam Nagar and Nangloi connect Najafgarh to west Delhi along the Najafgarh Road corridor. Domestic help in Najafgarh usually comes from within the town and its adjoining villages, and working arrangements are agreed directly with households, since gated societies are rare in this part of Delhi.
najafgarh.commuteNotes: The Grey Line's Najafgarh and Dhansa Bus Stand stations link the town to Dwarka, and buses along Najafgarh Road connect it to west Delhi; most helpers live within the town or adjoining villages and travel short distances on foot or by shared auto.
najafgarh.housingNotes: Plotted independent houses dominate and gated societies are rare, so households deal with helpers directly, and full-day or multi-visit arrangements are easy to structure.

Households are mainly settled families, many with members working at the airport, in government service or in offices towards Dwarka and Gurugram. Mahavir Enclave adjoins Palam to the north, Dwarka's sectors begin immediately to the west, and Delhi Cantt stretches along the eastern boundary, so domestic helpers circulate easily between these areas on foot and by shared auto. Homes here rarely have society-style gate controls; timings and entry are agreed directly with the household, and part-time help across mornings and evenings is the common working pattern in these lanes.
palam.commuteNotes: The Magenta Line's Palam station and the Palam Railway Station both serve the area, and helpers from adjacent colonies commonly walk or take shared autos along the Dabri–Palam corridor.
palam.housingNotes: The mix of village homes and compact builder floors means few formal gate controls; entry is handled by the household, and helpers often serve several homes in the same lane.

localFaqs.q: Which pincodes does Palam service cover?
localFaqs.a: Palam spans pincodes 110045 and 110061, covering the village core and colonies such as Raj Nagar and Sadh Nagar. Mahavir Enclave and Dwarka adjoin Palam under their own pincodes.

nangal-raya.commuteNotes: Buses along the Janakpuri–Dhaula Kuan corridor pass directly through Nangal Raya, and Janakpuri East and Janakpuri West stations on the Blue Line are a short ride away; many helpers walk in from adjacent west Delhi colonies.

localFaqs.a: Service extends to the surrounding colonies including Tilak Nagar, Janakpuri, Tagore Garden and Rajouri Garden. These areas sit directly around Hari Nagar along the Jail Road and Najafgarh Road corridors.

localFaqs.q: Which pincode does the Hari Nagar service cover?
localFaqs.a: Hari Nagar falls under pincode 110064, covering its lettered blocks along Jail Road. Homes near the Ghanta Ghar crossing and around Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital are all included.

localFaqs.q: How do helpers reach Hari Nagar without a metro station in the colony?
localFaqs.a: Most come by bus along Jail Road or walk from the nearby Blue Line stations at Tilak Nagar and Subhash Nagar. Helpers based in the adjacent Khyala area reach homes on foot.
